name: PDC Clearance Queue
query: SELECT name AS "PDC:Link/PDC:160", pdc_status AS "Status:Data:150", customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:180", cheque_no AS "Cheque No:Data:140", reference_date AS "Cheque Date:Date:120", DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), reference_date) AS "Days Due:Int:90", amount AS "Amount:Currency:120", cleared_amount AS "Cleared:Currency:120", (amount - IFNULL(cleared_amount, 0)) AS "Remaining:Currency:120", payment_entry AS "Customer Payment Entry:Link/Payment Entry:180", handed_over_to_supplier AS "Endorsed Supplier:Link/Supplier:180", supplier_payment_entry AS "Supplier Payment Entry:Link/Payment Entry:180", clearance_bank_account AS "Clearance Bank Account:Link/Account:180", pdc_receivable_account AS "PDC Receivable Account:Link/Account:180" FROM `tabPDC` WHERE docstatus = 1 AND pdc_status IN ('Pending', 'Ready for Clearance', 'Approved for Clearance', 'Handed Over', 'Partially Cleared') AND reference_date <= CURDATE() ORDER BY reference_date ASC, modified DESC
